response.explanation: At src/presentation/server.ts:2, the presentation-layer entry file imports BookingRepository from the persistence layer. It uses it only once, at line 14, where it builds `new BookingRepository()` and passes it to the RinkService constructor (lines 12-28). The same file also builds the other persistence classes (lines 1, 3-5) and the business service (line 6). It then passes the service to createApp (line 32). In practice the file is the app's composition root: it wires the app together at startup and never queries bookings itself. FF-S03 still flags it because the rule works at module level. A presentation module that imports a persistence module skips the business layer, whatever the reason for the import. No project documentation, ADR or comment was provided that names server.ts as an allowed wiring point. So no exception can be claimed, and the code alone can't show that the layer-skip is intended.
